regions.text: 因果約消極的偶然の親念は、この引用が示す刻く最近に至つて謂はゆる不確定原理に基いて最子力學約偶然性として背定され、自然科學は微小の非決定を主張する非決定論に優位を與へる傾向を示して来た。さうしてその哲學展望の遠大なることを力説する論者も次第に増加して水た（Ed.LeRoy,Cequela・Mic

quote.translation: As this quotation shows, the concept of negative causal contingency has recently come to be affirmed as so-called quantum-mechanical contingency, on the basis of the uncertainty principle, and natural science has come to show a tendency to give the advantage to the indeterminism that asserts a minute indeterminacy.
Theorists who stress how far-reaching its philosophical outlook is have also gradually grown in number (cf. Ed.
Le Roy, "Ce que la Microphysique apporte ou suggère à la Philosophie", Revue de Métaphysique et de Morale, 1935, esp.

regions.text: 然しながら、不確定性原理は必ずしもすべての有力なる自然科學者の承認するところではないのみならず、また自然科學的思催の本質そのものと果してどの程度に相容れるものかもなほ多少疑間とすべきであらう（EMeyerson,Duche-minementdelapenseeI,p63-64,TIp763-765,T68-189参照）。

quote.translation: Yet not every influential natural scientist necessarily accepts the uncertainty principle, and it should also remain somewhat doubtful how far it is compatible with the essence of natural-scientific thinking itself (cf. É.
Meyerson, Du cheminement de la pensée I, pp. 63-64, III, pp. 763-765, 768-769).

regions.text: また他方にはこれらの間題は從死の形面上劉（metaphysiague＝超物理築）の餌域とは異なる知予上勢（metamicrophy-sigue＝超徴物理學）の園内に感することを主張する論者もあるやうな次第であつて（G.Bchelard,NoumeneetMicrophysigque.Recherchesphilosophiques1,p.55-85）、事態は哲學地平に於てなほ明朗性を狭いてるる。

quote.translation: There are also theorists who claim that these problems belong to the sphere of a "quantum metaphysics" (métamicrophysique, ultra-microphysics), distinct from the domain of the former metaphysics (métaphysique, ultra-physics) (G. Bachelard, "Noumène et Microphysique", Recherches philosophiques I, pp. 55-65), so that on philosophical ground the state of affairs still lacks clarity.

regions.text: 哲學する者は謂はゆる最子力學偶然性そのものの價値を除りに誇大に考へてはならないかも知れぬ。

quote.translation: Those who philosophise should perhaps not overrate the value of so-called quantum-mechanical contingency itself.
Since the state of affairs is as it is, we shall for the time being leave open the question of whether negative causal contingency exists in the so-called "domain of objects".
